title: Docs-coverage sidecar
description: One file per registry feature, named by the percent-encoded id (only %, : and / are encoded): alias:invoke -> alias%3Ainvoke.json. See ADR-005.

id.description: The registry feature id; must encode to this file's name.

userFacing.description: Set true to bring a backend feature into scope. Cannot take a frontend or root feature out of scope.

website.description: <website docs collection id>[#anchor], for example help/getting-started#install.

tour.description: Tour id (tours/<id>.mdx); that tour's tour.features must list this id.

exempt.description: Reason this feature needs no docs. Excludes help, website and tour; needs approver.

approver.description: GitHub login that approved the exemption.

status.description: Pre-existing gap recorded by make docs-coverage-baseline. Only valid for ids on the base branch; drop it once help and website exist.
